description: IaC + GitOps decomposed. Terraform state, providers, modules. Pulumi component model. ArgoCD + Flux reconciliation. Image automation, secret management in GitOps, multi-cluster.

sub_mechanisms.name: terraform_state
sub_mechanisms.definition: JSON file mapping resources in code to real cloud resources. Stored remote (S3 + DynamoDB lock).
sub_mechanisms.why: Tracks what TF manages. Lock prevents concurrent applies. State must be backed up + version-controlled separately.

sub_mechanisms.name: terraform_provider
sub_mechanisms.definition: Plugin that talks to specific cloud API. AWS provider, GCP provider, K8s provider, etc.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decouples TF core from API specifics. Thousands of providers. Each provider versioned independently.

sub_mechanisms.name: terraform_module
sub_mechanisms.definition: Reusable group of resources. Inputs + outputs. Published to Terraform Registry.
sub_mechanisms.why: DRY. Standard pattern for reusable infra (VPC module, EKS module). Tag-based versioning.

sub_mechanisms.name: terraform_plan_apply_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: plan: dry-run, show diff. apply: execute. State updated after apply.
sub_mechanisms.why: Review before change. Plan in PR; apply on merge. Standard workflow. Prevents accidental destruction.

sub_mechanisms.name: terraform_workspace
sub_mechanisms.definition: Multiple state files for same config. dev/staging/prod separate workspaces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Reuse config; separate state. Trade: workspace switching error-prone. Many teams use separate directories + Terragrunt instead.

sub_mechanisms.name: pulumi_component_resource
sub_mechanisms.definition: Logical group of resources. First-class abstraction in Pulumi. Python/TS class.
sub_mechanisms.why: Higher-level than Terraform modules. Encapsulation + inheritance. Better abstraction; cost: imperative thinking.

sub_mechanisms.name: ArgoCD_application
sub_mechanisms.definition: Argo CRD: source (Git URL + path) + destination (cluster + namespace). Controller syncs.
sub_mechanisms.why: GitOps unit. App-of-apps pattern: one Argo Application points to repo full of others. Organisational hierarchy.

sub_mechanisms.name: ArgoCD_sync_strategies
sub_mechanisms.definition: Manual sync (button-press), automated (continuous), with prune + self-heal options.
sub_mechanisms.why: Trade-off: control vs automation. Production: automated with manual override on critical paths. Dev: full automated.

sub_mechanisms.name: Flux_HelmRelease
sub_mechanisms.definition: Flux Helm-Controller: declarative Helm release as K8s resource. Source from Git or Helm repo.
sub_mechanisms.why: Helm + GitOps. Flux manages Helm lifecycle declaratively. Helm values from Git or Secret.

sub_mechanisms.name: image_automation_GitOps
sub_mechanisms.definition: Watch container registry; on new tag matching policy, commit update to Git.
sub_mechanisms.why: Automate image rollout without CI push. Flux Image Automation, ArgoCD Image Updater. GitOps without manual bumping.

sub_mechanisms.name: secret_management_GitOps
sub_mechanisms.definition: Secrets shouldn't be in Git. Patterns: SealedSecrets (encrypted), External Secrets Operator (sync from Vault/AWS SM).
sub_mechanisms.why: Plaintext secrets in Git = leak. SealedSecrets: encrypted, only cluster can decrypt. ESO: secret reference; actual fetch from cloud secret store at runtime.

sub_mechanisms.name: drift_detection_reconciliation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Controller detects difference between Git + cluster. Reconciles (overwrites cluster) or alerts.
sub_mechanisms.why: Manual cluster changes drift from Git. GitOps tools detect + correct (or warn). Foundation property: cluster always matches Git.

derivation_rules.name: terraform_state_must_be_backed_up
then: TF doesn't know what it manages → imports needed
derivation_rules.why: State is mapping code → real resources. Lost = TF sees empty world; recreates everything (or refuses). Remote backend + versioning + lock essential.

derivation_rules.name: GitOps_pull_better_than_push_CI
if: deploys via GitOps agent in cluster
then: fewer credentials exposed, auto-reconciliation, drift detection
derivation_rules.why: Push CI: CI has cluster credentials, deployment is one-shot. Pull: cluster pulls from Git, no creds outside cluster, continuously reconciled. Standard direction.

derivation_rules.name: drift_detection_prevents_silent_divergence
derivation_rules.why: Without: cluster reality grows away from declared. With: visible drift, source of truth maintained. ArgoCD/Flux fundamental capability.

derivation_rules.name: SealedSecrets_keeps_secrets_in_Git_safely
derivation_rules.why: Encrypted by cluster's controller pubkey. Git-safe. Bitnami's design. Alternative: ESO references external secret store.

derivation_rules.name: automated_image_updates_close_GitOps_loop
if: image automation watches registry + commits to Git
derivation_rules.why: Builder pushes image; image automation sees new tag; commits manifests update; GitOps pulls + deploys. End-to-end without push CI.
